title: Teleshopping
desc: Learn about a wide selection of products and take advantage of a convenient method of shopping. A show for those who love to shop from the comforts of their home.

title: Khaki
desc: Chiru becomes part of a 'vigilance group', that fights crimes in the neighbourhood. However, their group lands in trouble when a businessman creates problems for them.

title: Butterfly
desc: Geetha battles to rescue her sister's kidnapped children. In her desperate mission, she unearths disturbing truths about her seemingly ordinary neighbours.

title: Surya The Soldier

title: Veera The Power
desc: Porus, a strong-minded IPS aspirant from a middle-class family in Chennai, comes across a series of dark secrets while investigating his sister's murder.

title: Shanmukha
desc: A law officer and research scholar investigate an ancient Indian temple's enigmas, tracking scriptures and folklore. Thus, they uncover deity secrets and hidden forest treasure.
